fortress-office.name: Fortress Corporate Offices
fortress-office.text: Lived-in medieval fortress converted to normal corporate work: stone vaults, arched windows, eye-emblem maroon banners, paper files, desk calendars, mugs, torches and practical workstations. The raids and dungeons remain visible beyond office windows.

war-room.name: Post-Battle Conference Room
war-room.text: Large stone-walled war-room with long meeting table, campaign maps, attendance records, enchanted projection maps and consequences of military loss in view.

wizard-lab.name: Wizard Research Department
wizard-lab.text: Stone-arched magical research office with one clear work surface and a few recognizable research details. Keep background shelves sparse and subdued. Only the current strip's story-required prototypes, cursed products, vials, spell displays or paperwork should appear prominently; do not populate tables with incidental magical clutter.

dungeon-transport.name: Dungeon Transfer Authority
dungeon-transport.text: Evil fortress prison transfer lobby with barred cell doors, visible cell numbers, chained captives, clipboard-carrying orc attendants, grim airline-style queues and departure notices.

dungeon.name: Dungeon Operations
dungeon.text: Real working prison inside a fortress: iron cells, hostile traps, chains, shackles, torchlight, guard posts and prisoner movement.

treasure-vault.name: Dragon Hoard and Company Vault
treasure-vault.text: Mountain of gold and jewels mixed with labeled payroll chests, financial records and disputed company assets in a vaulted treasury.

fortress-yard.name: Fortress Military Courtyard
fortress-yard.text: Working evil army base with large company banners, returning wounded troops, siege gear, training yards, smoke and pallets of raiding supplies.

supply-yard.name: Raid Logistics Depot
supply-yard.text: Stone-and-timber supply depot with wagons, crates, relief packages, assigned targets and marching soldiers; raiding and aid share the same warehouse.

elven-front.name: Elven Defensive Frontier
elven-front.text: A competent and beautiful elven border fortress built of sturdy pale stone and forest timbers; clear contrast to the scorched evil army camp.

training-room.name: Workplace Training and HR Room
training-room.text: Stone fortress classroom with mundane meeting table, flip-board, elf and orc attendees, enchanted office presentation and company banners.

breakroom.name: Fortress Employee Breakroom
breakroom.text: Ordinary lived-in breakroom in stone fortress: mugs, pastries, coffee urn, battered table, meal storage, maroon company banner and visible troop traffic.

facilities.name: Fortress Facilities Corridor
facilities.text: Aged stone corridor with arched halls, plumbing, dripping moat water, repairs in progress, cleaning carts, torches and a maintenance worker's tools.

accounting.name: Accounting and HR Office
accounting.text: Stuffy stone fortress office with ledgers, thick binders, financial notices, skeleton workers at desks, clerical equipment and necromancy implements.

ominous-hole.name: Ominous Hole Outpost
ominous-hole.text: Stone-ringed bottomless-looking dark hole in a desolate fortress outpost, simple rope barrier and maroon eye-symbol banners; no confirmed creature inside.

elven-village.name: Occupied Villages
elven-village.text: Human and elven villages with ordinary inhabitants, reconstruction labor, fields, market squares, damage from raids and company soldiers occupying nearby streets.

dark-lord-office.name: Regional Executive Chamber
dark-lord-office.text: Severe imposing executive throne-room with strategic battle maps, ranked banners, controlled lighting, imperial records and evidence of ongoing conquest.
